verdict.rationale: 1Password documents two REST APIs with downloadable OpenAPI specs and interactive reference playgrounds. The Connect Server API manages items and vaults, and the Events API handles audit and activity data, with documented path versioning and a changelog. These are backed by SDKs in Go, JavaScript and Python that let integrations programmatically manage items. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, a general hosted REST API (Connect requires deploying your own server and is described as a private REST API), and an account-wide or Connect API deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: 1Password Connect Servers allow you to securely access your 1Password items and vaults in your company's apps and cloud infrastructure using a private REST API.
The 1Password Connect Server API likewise ships a downloadable OpenAPI document (3.0.2, version 1.8.1), linked from the Connect API reference as the specification file.
1Password publishes the Events API as a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document (semver 1.4.1)
The Events API and Connect API references run the Mintlify interactive playground
1Password SDKs allow you to build integrations that programmatically interact with 1Password using Go, JavaScript, or Python.
